title: Trajectory
description: What one branch did while attempting an unknown task. Emitted by the branching search (TON-13), consumed by the pairwise judge (TON-19) and the distiller (TON-21). Hand-rolled because sail.Voyage is write-only and cannot be exported - see sail-notes.md.

branch_id.description: Unique within a fan-out, e.g. b0/b1/b2.

angle.description: The distinct approach this branch was told to take. Branches given identical prompts produce identical trajectories and the judge has nothing to compare - so this must actually differ.

task.description: The original request, verbatim. The distiller needs it to know what to generalize toward.

steps.description: Everything the branch tried, INCLUDING dead ends. The judge reads failures as signal; the distiller strips them. Recording only what worked destroys both.

action.description: What was done: a shell command, a browser op, or a reasoning step.

observation_excerpt.description: What came back, truncated. Full page dumps blow out the judge's context for no gain.

outcome.description: abandoned = tried, didn't fail outright, but the branch moved on. This is what marks a dead end for the distiller.

note.description: Optional: why this was tried or dropped.

final_answer.description: What the branch concluded. May be absent if it failed.

success_signal.description: Did the branch believe it completed the task? Self-reported and NOT trusted as ground truth - the judge exists precisely because this is unreliable.

error.description: Present when the branch died rather than finished.
